intro.h2: Cabinets and Countertops Planned Around Your Kitchen
paragraphs: United Kitchen & Bath handles kitchen remodeling in Kenner from its location at 2304 Marietta St. The work centers on what most kitchens need first: new cabinets, new countertops and a layout that fits the room you actually have.

Customers mention the measuring visit most. One homeowner wrote that the salesman measured the space, offered several options and did not push more than was needed. Another said Juan always delivered on exactly what he promised. On Facebook the team describes itself as a kitchen and bath designer for the New Orleans area, and you can stop in seven days a week, including Sundays from 10 AM to 2 PM.

services.h2: Kitchen and Bath Services in Kenner

items.name: Kitchen cabinets
items.blurb: New kitchen cabinets come up in more Google reviews than any other job. The team measures the room, talks you through several options for the best fit, and an installation crew sets the cabinets once they arrive. Ask which styles and finishes are available when you call.

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Countertops sit next to kitchen remodeling as a main service on the company's Facebook page. Choosing the top together with new cabinets means one team plans the whole kitchen. Call to ask which counter materials they offer right now and how each one fits your budget.

items.name: Kitchen and bath design
items.blurb: The Facebook page calls United Kitchen & Bath a kitchen and bath designer for the New Orleans area. In practice that starts with a visit to measure, a few layout ideas to compare, and straight advice on what your room needs, without being pushed into buying more.

why_choose_us.h2: Why Kenner Homeowners Call United Kitchen & Bath

items.title: Measured before you buy
items.text: A reviewer described the salesman measuring the kitchen first, then giving several options and suggestions for the best fit. Your plan starts from real dimensions, not a guess.

about.text: United Kitchen & Bath is a kitchen remodeler at 2304 Marietta St in Kenner, Louisiana. Its Facebook page describes the business as a kitchen and bath designer for the New Orleans area that works with the newest materials. service_area.h2: Kitchen Remodeling in Kenner and the New Orleans Area
service_area.text: United Kitchen & Bath works from 2304 Marietta St in Kenner. Google lists Kenner as its home base, and the company's Facebook page describes it as serving the New Orleans area. If you live nearby and want new kitchen cabinets or countertops, call to confirm they cover your street before you book a measuring visit. Weekend hours make it easy to stop in and talk through a plan.

items.a: United Kitchen & Bath is open Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM, and Saturday and Sunday from 10 AM to 2 PM. Those are the hours listed on Google, so call (504) 780-8400 before you drive over if you want to be sure someone is free to talk.

The business is at 2304 Marietta St, Kenner, LA 70062. Google lists it there as a kitchen remodeler, and the Facebook page describes the team as kitchen and bath designers for the New Orleans area. Call ahead if you want to set a time to sit down and plan.

items.q: What kind of work do you do?
items.a: The main services are kitchen remodeling, kitchen cabinets and countertops. Google reviews talk mostly about new cabinets and their installation, and the Facebook page lists countertops next to kitchen remodeling. If you are planning a bathroom, ask on the phone whether that fits what they currently offer.

items.q: Do you come out and measure?
items.a: One Google reviewer wrote that the salesman measured the area and then gave several options and suggestions for the best fit. Ask when you call how the measuring visit is scheduled and whether there is any charge for it, since pricing is not published.

items.q: Do you offer free estimates or financing?
items.a: Neither free estimates nor financing is mentioned on the Google listing or the Facebook page, so ask when you call. The team can tell you how quotes work for cabinets and countertops and what lead time to expect for your order.
